answer: Newcomers begin on an isolated island shard with tiny jobs only. To climb the terrace toward full standing, each identity must present signed receipts of real infrastructure spend, compute and API bills paid to independent providers, bound to one long-lived key. Reaching the zenith of standing requires months of such receipts plus verified deliveries. A Sybil farm must pay a genuine bill for every fake, so mass identities cost mass money, while an honest agent's normal operating spend doubles as its credential.
